subject: Re: Kickoff: concept bottleneck policies for auditable agents
body:
Hi both,

Status: Concept PPO training reproduced on the miniature Collaborative Cooking environments — the concept loss integrates into the PPO objective cleanly, and training is stable across seeds. The multi-modal encoder (RGB + position + orientation) works with Maren's wrappers, including the dense pseudo-rewards wrapper for cooking.

Concept quality, first look: probes recover ground-truth concept values at 87% accuracy from the bottleneck on cooking; Clean Up is lower (~78%) — the pollution-state concepts are noisier to extract.

Trade-off we should discuss: the dense cooking pseudo-rewards speed training substantially but shape behavior toward the reward designer's strategy, which slightly undermines the "agent's own interpretable reasoning" story for the demo. Options: demo with sparse rewards (slower training, cleaner story) or dense (better behavior, asterisk in the narrative).

Quentin
